current_difficulty_reason: The cited unitary representation results do not classify invariant random orders on the smaller automorphism group. The authors obtain the required conditional independence, reconstruct uniform orders from non-atomic conditional statistics, and use alternating type paths together with successive atomic conditioning to force a Dirac invariant order in the remaining case. Those compatibility and conditioning constructions give the dichotomy before the final ergodic-decomposition step.
